evidence.quote: Farr’s Dalston is a buzzy bar, pub, and private hire event venue that’s become a local favourite.

findings.value: Private hire of the basement bar starts at £200 for a whole evening, for up to 100 guests. Catering and bar options are on request.

evidence.quote: Host your event for up to 100 guest in our private basement venue from £200 for the whole evening.
Catering and bar options are available ​​on request.

notes: Capacity for the editor: the venue hire page gives figures only for the basement room (standing 'Between 80-100 people', seated 'Up to 45 seats'), so no whole-venue capacity is proposed. The 'Getting Here' section gives directions only, no access detail; no access statement was found. The venue's own pages give no entry price or age policy for general nights. The ma.to listing (aggregator) gives the same street address.
